```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", nrow(movies)),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap |>
  distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(gap < 0) |>
  slice_min(gap, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(gap) |>
  select(title, audienceScore, tomatoMeter, gap)
```
